payload.body: The grant covers staff and operating costs, giving a new program a life beyond the launch announcement. Jupiter trine Saturn can make growth easier to sustain because the opportunity arrives with enough structure to support it. Hiring, schedules, reporting, and long-term funding are what keep the idea from disappearing after the first wave of attention. Use the support to build those ordinary systems now. A program lasts because somebody planned for month six as carefully as opening day.
